title: Which load balancer?
claim: The kind of traffic decides the type of load balancer.
alt: A decision ladder with three questions. If traffic must pass through virtual appliances, choose a Gateway Load Balancer. If not, and requests are routed by HTTP path or host, choose an Application Load Balancer. If not, and the traffic is TCP, UDP or TLS, choose a Network Load Balancer. Otherwise read the requirement again.
